steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Create the required Technical and RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add one product line for the event.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the required 30-minute schedule.
Invite one QA vendor, representing Vendor A.
Publish the completed eRFX event.
Assert that publishing reached the project page.
Have the invited vendor answer the Technical stage and submit a price of 100 through the vendor portal.
Assert that the vendor submission was accepted.
Inspect the vendor's separate portal session.
Open the Technical-stage view where the clauses should be presented.
Assert that the required Technical-stage clause is visible to the vendor.
Assert that the optional Technical-stage clause is visible to the vendor.
Open the RFQ pricing stage to check that Technical-only clauses are not presented there.
Assert that the required Technical-stage clause is absent from the RFQ stage.
Assert that the other Technical-stage clause is absent from the RFQ stage.
